name: CSC Financial Co., Ltd.
summary: CSC Financial Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides investment banking services in Mainland China and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Investment Banking, Wealth Management, Trading and Institutional Client Services, and Asset Management. The company offers securities brokerage, securities investment consultancy, financial advisory services, securities underwriting and sponsoring, trading and investment of securities, securities asset management, agency sale of securities investment funds, margin financing and securities lending services, agency sale of financial products, and market-making of stock options.
